# Santosh S. Lad — Official Website

> Official website of Santosh S. Lad, Minister for Labour, Government of Karnataka, and Member of Legislative Assembly (MLA) from Kalaghatagi.

## Key Information
- **Role:** Minister for Labour, Government of Karnataka
- **Constituency:** Kalaghatagi (Four-time elected MLA)
- **Key Initiatives:** Labourer Welfare schemes, Disaster Relief Operations, Janatha Darshan Public Grievance redressal, Youth Empowerment & Skill Development.

## Main Links
- [Home Page](https://www.santoshlad.com/) - Overview of public service, career background, and key initiatives.
- [Latest Feed](https://www.santoshlad.com/latest) - Official news updates, press releases, public announcements, and activity reports.
- [Gallery](https://www.santoshlad.com/gallery) - High-resolution press images and public event coverage.
- [Timeline](https://www.santoshlad.com/timeline) - Historical overview of career milestones, legislative achievements, and public service record.

## Contact & Public Grievance
- **Janatha Darshan:** Direct public grievance hearings for constituents of Kalaghatagi and workers across Karnataka.
